mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.category_id, t.amount, t.txn_date, t.direction, t.memo, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, c.name AS category_name FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.txn_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.category_id, t.amount, t.txn_date, t.direction, t.memo, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at, c.name AS category_name FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, category_id, amount, txn_date, direction, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{txnDate}, #{direction}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET category_id = #{categoryId}, amount = #{amount}, txn_date = #{txnDate}, direction = #{direction}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(c.name, '未分類') AS category_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND TO_CHAR(t.txn_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY COALESCE(c.name, '未分類') ORDER BY total_amount DESC
